transcript: This is AgriPulse OpenBike. I'm your host Jeff Daley. Our guest this week is Montana U.S. Senator John Tester. AgriPulse OpenBike is brought to you by Growing Matters. Growing Matters is an industry coalition sharing science-based information about the crucial role Neonicotinoids play and how food is produced. Learn more at neonicfacts.org. AgriPulse open mic continues with Montana Senator John Tester next. Neonicotinoids or Neonicks are a class of pesticides that are vital to agriculture and are cornerstones of modern integrated pest management. For more than 25 years, Neonicks have played an important role in sustaining communities and help ensure farmers are able to grow the food, fuel and fiber we need. Not using NeoNix would undermine the very practices that keep destructive pests in check and would negatively impact farmers, families, communities, and the environment. That is why growing matters, a coalition led by BASF Agricultural Solutions, Bayer, Mizzoui Chemicals, Agro, Inc., Syngenta, and VailitUSA LLC has launched neonicfacts.org to share science-based information about the crucial role Neil Nick's play and how food is produced. To find out more about the important role Neil Nick's play in North American agriculture, share the facts and learn the sources such as the EPA and Ag Informatics, visit neonicfacts.org. This is Agropulse Open Mike. With partisan winds blowing on Capitol Hill, opportunities seem limited to accomplish many legislative tasks this year. Montana Senator John Tester says geopolitical events with Russia and China are adding tension to an already complex legislative outlook.

And I applaud your efforts and want to thank you for them because Truth is, we're all in this together. And what I said earlier about, if we see the family farm operations go away, whether it's ranches or farms or small processors, whatever it might be, that's going to do harm to this country's national security and certainly do our food security. So we need to be smart and we need to react in a way that's, it's an ease of this country moving forward. And you doing this show and all the other things you do, are very important to making sure that we're doing the right thing by production agriculture.
